A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 18 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:P2P-D-deathstardockingcontrolroom327-PC-Errata-2019-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Death Star: Docking Control Room 327 (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, with the printed art, title and lore (490 × 350 pixels); a small round bronze disc at the lower right marks it as errata.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2019 disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
